comment: The book's most distinctive move is treating abstention as the central engineering challenge rather than a bug. The 'grades of no' taxonomy in Ch. 5 is the strongest original contribution, and the 10-check checklist in Ch. 10 is the right shape for a field that needs discipline over demos.

proof_of_reading.last_sentence: Good luck out there — and write your own log entries the same day you earn them.
summary_3x15: Small local models can serve plant floors if grounded, constrained, and honestly evaluated.
Abstention — reliable refusal — matters more than accuracy for industrial deployments.
The deployment gate, built from your own data with error bars, is the real innovation.
proof_of_reading.antithesis: The book's central premise — that a locally run small model can be made honest enough for industrial use — collapses if the plant lacks the engineering discipline to build the grounding pipeline and evaluation gate, because no model size or quantization compensates for lazy rendering and absent measurement.
